long_biography.plain_text:
Samuel Carlyle Logan Sr. established his construction career in Sarasota, Florida. He qualified as a certified residential contractor and served as director and registered agent when Logan Construction Group’s original corporation was formed in 1991. Elizabeth Logan served as secretary, making the early business a family enterprise.

Logan remained associated with the construction group as its residential work expanded beyond Sarasota. The business became known for custom and luxury homes in Florida and projects in the Bahamas and the Virgin Islands. His durable public profile is that of a contractor and construction executive rather than a developer of a large public company.
